what_to_detect: A keyword trigger whose cost variable an effect defines from the game state (echo X where X is a life total) resolves and asks for the cost the variable has at resolution: paid at that amount, the permanent stays.
near_miss: The same kind of trigger whose cost, evaluated at resolution, cannot be paid, so the permanent is sacrificed.
record_fields: snapshot player life before the effect half
payload.events zone_change battlefield to graveyard (the sacrifice)
acting keyword line (a keyword-derived trigger, no Mode$)
